checks.describe: core-internals profile is up and the worker node exists
DRA example driver is installed — ResourceSlices exist for gpu.example.com
Kueue controller manager pod is running in kueue-system namespace
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n kueue-system get pods --no-headers --field-selector=status.phase=Running | wc -l | tr -d ' \n'

checks.describe: a ResourceClaim requesting a GPU has been allocated by the DRA driver
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m8-lab get resourceclaims --no-headers 2>/dev/null | head -1

checks.describe: ClusterQueue m8-cq is created with GPU resource flavors
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core get clusterqueue m8-cq -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: LocalQueue m8-lq exists in m8-lab namespace and points to m8-cq
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m8-lab get localqueue m8-lq -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterQueue}' 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: at least one Job has been admitted by Kueue (Admitted condition True)
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m8-lab get workloads --no-headers 2>/dev/null | head -1
